item.title: ‘KPop Demon Hunters,’ ‘Song Sung Blue,’ Billy Joel Doc & More Nominated for 2026 Humanitas Prizes: Full List
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest news and trends in the entertainment industry. Today, we're talking about the 2026 Humanitas Prize nominations. For those who may not know, the Humanitas Prize honors TV and film writers who explore the human condition in their work.
[Soft music transition]
Host: This year's nominees include some exciting projects. In the family feature category, we have KPop Demon Hunters, which had a Billboard 200-topping soundtrack album, competing against Elio, Grow, and Hoppers. In the drama feature category, Song Sung Blue, a film about a Neil Diamond tribute performer and his wife, is nominated alongside All That's Left of You, Preparation for the Next Life, and Train Dreams.
[Short music transition]
Host: The documentary category is also filled with interesting nominees. Billy Joel: And So It Goes ("Part Two") is nominated for its candid look at Billy Joel's life, including his struggles with depression and alcoholism. Other nominees in this category include Katrina: Come Hell and High Water, Mel Brooks: The 99 Year Old Man!, and Rise of the 49ers.
[Soft music continues]
Host: The Humanitas Prize has been recognizing writers who explore the human condition since 1974. Past winners include iconic shows like All in the Family, ER, and black-ish, as well as films like Hidden Figures and Good Will Hunting.
[Short music transition]
Host: This year's awards will take place on September 9th at Avalon Hollywood, hosted by writer-comedian Ashley Nicole Black. We'll also see Winnie Holzman, creator of My So-Called Life, receive the Kieser Award for her contributions to stories that celebrate common humanity.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today's podcast. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll see you next time! [Outro music continues to play until the end]
